expectations.text: Tells the user to run gh auth login
expectations.evidence: 'run `gh auth login` and I'll pick this up'

expectations.text: Does NOT produce a full PR description markdown
expectations.evidence: Output contains only the stop message, no description

expectations.text: Does NOT fall back to scraping / WebFetch / webpage fetching
expectations.evidence: Explicitly rules out WebFetch: 'WebFetch can't read the repo (it's private)'

expectations.text: Does NOT pretend to analyze a local branch the user didn't ask about
expectations.evidence: Explicitly rules out local-branch fallback: 'silently swapping targets is worse than no answer'
